description: Spawn changes of map4_s05 (Central Silent Hill Otherworld, the Floatstinger boss): while M4S05_CybilStairsCutsceneDone is set and M4S05_FloatstingerKilled clear, on any difficulty, Floatstinger's row 0 gets spawn_2. Each entry has "when" (all of: "difficulty" easy/normal/hard, "flags_set" and "flags_clear" event flag names that must be set / clear; nested "all"/"any" lists combine conditions) and "set", a list of writes: "chara" is a character name, "slot" the row of the map's spawn table for that character (as the second argument of sh.chara_spawn_flags_set) and "flags" the spawn flags the row gets, which the spawned character starts its state from ("none" = 0, the row stays empty; spawn_0.. spawn_4 are the bits). Entries apply when the map loads, in file order (a later one wins); a mod's own entries are appended unless they carry an "id" that replaces an entry.
